data.name: Subtitle
data.value: Discover playtime patterns, with every insight grounded in the available Steam snapshot.

data.name: DistributionNote
data.value: Counts and bars describe returned games only; unknown time has its own group.

data.name: TopNote
data.value: Known playtime only. The Games page contains the complete available list.

data.name: SnapshotNote
data.value: Calculated locally from the loaded library. No extra Steam requests or historical tracking.

data.name: KnownTotal
data.value: TIME IN RETURNED GAMES WITH KNOWN PLAYTIME

data.name: SelectHint
data.value: Select a top game to open its store page or copy its AppID.

data.name: CoverageHint
data.value: Open a profile to discover its Library Pulse.

data.name: Idle
data.value: Open any Steam profile using the search above.

data.name: Ready
data.value: Library snapshot ready. Whole-library metrics use complete playtime coverage.

data.name: Partial
data.value: Steam returned a partial library. The distribution describes only returned games.

data.name: Empty
data.value: Steam returned a complete, empty library.

data.name: Private
data.value: The library is private or access was denied. Its contents are unknown.

data.name: MissingKey
data.value: Configure GAMEPULSE_STEAM_API_KEY to load the library.

data.name: RateLimited
data.value: Steam is limiting requests. Try refreshing later.

data.name: Failed
data.value: The library could not be analyzed. Refresh the profile to try again.

data.name: Unavailable
data.value: The library is unavailable. No totals or ownership assumptions are shown.

data.name: CompleteNote
data.value: Totals and never-played metrics cover the complete returned library. Percentages are N/A when their denominator is zero.

data.name: IncompleteNote
data.value: Whole-library totals, never-played counts and top-3 shares are N/A until the library and playtime coverage are complete.

data.name: TopCount
data.value: Showing {0:N0} of {1:N0} returned games with known time.

data.name: ClipboardFailed
data.value: The AppID could not be copied.

data.name: ExternalFailed
data.value: The Steam Store page could not be opened.
